derivation: probably akin to the base of G5530 (χράομαι) through the idea of handling;
def: the body (properly, its surface or skin)

occurrences.text: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
